subject: Initial discovery: coordination for integration program kickoff
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@hexamed.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial discovery: coordination for integration program kickoff

Hi Lisa —

Thanks again for the intro call last week. Based on our convo, it sounds like HexaMed wants to run a short discovery with your champion and engineering lead to do two things: scope the integration surface and run through security/procurement expectations. I'd like to get a 30–45 minute slot on the calendar with your champion + your engineering lead, and include our SE (Dev Patel) so we can answer architecture questions.

Are any of these slots good for your team (PST):
- Wed Apr 28, 10:00–10:45am
- Wed Apr 28, 2:30–3:15pm
- Thu Apr 29, 9:00–9:45am

If none work, please propose a couple times and we’ll adapt. Also, could you loop in procurement/security if they need to see any pre-call evidence? I can send a short checklist.

I’ve attached a one-pager that outlines the kickoff agenda.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

Attachment: Redwood-kickoff-one-pager.pdf (pdf)

From: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@hexamed.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.m@hexamed.com>, procurement@hexamed.com, security@hexamed.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial discovery: coordination for integration program kickoff

Hi Karthik —

Thanks — we’d like to get the champion (Rajiv) and our engineering lead (me) in the same call. Dev looks great to include. Procurement and security should be aware but won’t need to join the full call; they asked for an evidence checklist up front.

We can do Thu Apr 29 09:00–09:45am (PST). If possible, start with a short 10-minute architecture overview then deep-dive on API surface.

I’m attaching a short system diagram (redacted) and the security team’s evidence template. Procurement will follow up separately if they need contractual info.

Best,
Lisa
Director, Platform Engineering | HexaMed
lisa.chen@hexamed.com

Attachments: HexaMed-system-diagram-redacted.pdf (pdf); HexaMed-security-evidence-template.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@hexamed.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.m@hexamed.com>, procurement@hexamed.com, security@hexamed.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial discovery: coordination for integration program kickoff

Perfect — Thu Apr 29 09:00–09:45am PST works for us.

Agenda (30–40m):
- 0–10m: quick intros + high-level goals (champion + AE)
- 10–25m: engineering overview (Lisa + Dev) — data flows, auth, error handling
- 25–35m: security/procurement pre-checklist items + next steps
- 35–45m: action items & who owns what

Dev — can you bring any notes on expected rate limits and a short slide on auth options (API key vs mTLS)?

Lisa — I’ll send a calendar invite (Google) to lock the time and include the meeting link. I’ll also attach the short evidence checklist our security team prefers (just a starter — we don’t expect you to ship everything pre-demo).

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Karthik

Related link: https://cal.example.com/event?eid=abc123

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@hexamed.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.m@hexamed.com>, security@hexamed.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial discovery: coordination for integration program kickoff

Thanks Karthik — adding the slide pack.

Quick notes for the call:
- I’ll cover auth options and tradeoffs (API key, mTLS, token lifetimes).
- Typical integrations see initial throughput needs of ~50–200 reqs/min — if you can share expected QPS we’ll tailor the cost/latency discussion.
- If HexaMed uses a private VPC setup, we’ll walk through the private deployment checklist.

Attaching: Redwood-auth-options-slides.pdf (pdf).

If security wants anything more formal (SOC2 artefacts, runbooks), let me know and I’ll loop in our security ops owner.

—Dev
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood-auth-options-slides.pdf (pdf)

From: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@hexamed.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.m@hexamed.com>, procurement@hexamed.com, security@hexamed.com
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial discovery: coordination for integration program kickoff

Thanks everyone — confirmed Thu Apr 29 09:00–09:45am PST. Procurement will not join the live call but will expect the security evidence checklist you mentioned; I’ve added security@hexamed.com to the thread.

One small change: can we make it 09:15–10:00 instead? We have a standing team check at 09:00. If that’s not possible, we’ll keep 09:00.

If you can send the calendar invite for 09:15–10:00 PST I’ll accept and forward to the rest of the engineering team.

Cheers,
Lisa
